_comment: Gates known to fail for an owned, dated defect. Read by scripts/verify_source_registry.py. Explanation in KNOWN_RED.md. An entry past fix_by escalates to a hard failure - expiry is what stops this becoming a place defects go to be forgotten. A stale entry is not harmless: while gate 14's entry outlived its defect it absorbed an injected failure as known-red and the suite exited 2 instead of 1. Remove an entry the moment its gate goes green.
